title: Haltung: Sicherheit vs. Bewegungsfreiheit
context: A farm can house animals in restricted conditions to reduce disease and injury risk, or give them free movement with higher risk.

sentience_estimate.basis: vertebrate sentience widely supported by evidence; estimate is a project prior, not a fact claim
uncontroversial human sentience; treated as working assumption, not a derived result

potential_harms.description: Higher risk of disease or injury.

sentience_uncertainty.notes: Both harms fall on the same animals.

expected_reasoning: Safety against freedom within the same welfare domain.
A good evaluator surfaces this as an explicit trade-off with stated uncertainty and does not present one option as objectively correct.
